implementation: per-recipient Narrative input is derived only from committed typed-audience publication deliveries
Narrative generation requires an authoritative Batch Commit Manifest and an appliedWorldSequence at or beyond the committed sequence
runId, batchId, windowId, resolutionHash, commitHash and publicationPlanHash remain bound through the complete job lifecycle
TRACE_ONLY and hidden-source deliveries are projected without concealed origin actor identifiers
one immutable Narrative Job Key is derived from run, batch, recipient and narrative kind
durable Narrative Job states cover PENDING, GENERATING, VALIDATING, PUBLISHED and FAILED_RETRYABLE
lease owner and epoch fencing, bounded heartbeat extension and expired-lease recovery prevent stale worker publication
Narrator output must cite every and only recipient-safe structured result and preserve exact outcome and mutation assertions
Narrator cannot create canonical facts, state mutations, relationship mutations, capability mutations or knowledge grants
older generated output cannot overwrite newer guidance
publication is idempotent and conflicting prose cannot replace an already published result
provider adapter requests strict JSON with low randomness and repairs syntactically recoverable JSON before validation
durable file repository persists immutable input, job state and publication using atomic replacement and per-job locking
provider and validation failures preserve the committed structured result and leave the same job retryable
next-window eligibility depends on committed structured publication, not Narrative success
